messages:
Maria: Quick sync — finalizing the newsletter + webinar nurture sends for next week. Need: TZ send windows, subject-line variants (A/B), and the SDR handoff CSV for engaged attendees. Doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/launchpad/nurture
AJ: Proposal: 3 staggered windows by region to reduce queue spikes and avoid ISP throttling — APAC 9–11am local, EMEA 10–12 local, AMER 10–13 local. Stagger start times by 2 hours between groups. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sylvie: Sounds good. Also recommend pinning a single domain for the send (no new subdomain this week) — deliverability team flagged warmup risk. 
Noah: Noted re: domain. I can generate the SDR handoff export after the first digest send and again after webinar reminders. Need the segmentation rules asap.
Maria: Segments (short):
- trial-engaged: created account in last 90d AND opened 2+ emails in 30d
- product-active: API or console activity in last 30d (score >= 5)
- cold: no opens in 60d or unsubscribed list removed
Keep trial-engaged + product-active in cohort A (invite + reminder). Cold get a lighter invite + no follow-up.
AJ: Subject-line A/B ideas: 
A) "Join our webinar: Make LLM inference predictable"
B) "How to cut inference costs by 2x — webinar"
Plan: A/B at 50/50 within each segment and pick winner after 4h.
Sylvie: Creative checklist — include CTA for calendar add, short agenda bullets, and a small benchmark stat (p95 latency + cost per 1k tokens). Avoid heavy images for mobile.
Noah: @Maria — for SDR CSV, columns I need: email,first_name,segment,engagement_score,timezone,source,last_activity. Small sample:
```
email,first_name,segment,engagement_score,timezone,source,last_activity
k.tan@example.com,Kai,trial-engaged,7,Asia/Tokyo,webinar_reg,2026-03-10
s.lee@example.com,Sana,product-active,8,Europe/London,product_event,2026-03-11
```
Maria: Perfect. Also: handoff criteria = attended OR registered + visited docs + engagement_score >=6. Export cadence: initial after first send, final after webinar starts (to capture last-min attendees).
AJ: Reminder cadence for webinar drip: initial invite -> 3 days -> 1 day -> 2h prior (SMS if opted-in). For email-only hosts, skip SMS. Use `X-Send-Group` header to tag batches.
Sylvie: Can we run a seed cohort (1k addresses) across all ISPs to watch for bounces and Gmail clipping? LaunchBot: seed list scheduled, report will appear in #deliverability.
Noah: I'll prep the SDR doc and a quick sheet mapping timezones -> send window. Tagging @Maria for final review of copy.
Maria: Copy ready v1 in the doc, added subject variants and preheader tests. Please do the A/B split per AJ's plan. LaunchBot: Scheduling check — all required assets uploaded?
LaunchBot: Assets check: templates=ok, seed_list=ok, domain_warmup=stable, send_windows=configured. Queue window opens T-48h.
Sylvie: :thumbsup: Good. Last call on suppressions: global unsub + 30d complaint suppression + legal opt-out. Noah will you confirm suppression list merge?
Noah: Confirmed — will merge suppression sets T-24h and share final counts in the doc.
Maria: Great — will finalize schedule by EOD and post final CSV link here. Thanks team! :rocket:
